The Loudon-Douglas Alumni Association is a nonprofit founded in 1985 consisting of a a group of dedicated former students of Douglas High School and their descendants. The Loudon Douglas alumni provide financial aid and scholarship to young people who desire to pursue education beyond high school, at a trade school, at a college or university. Since their creation

And so it is a phenomenal story from start to finish.
